s.zh: 这具尸体不是血肉之躯。
s.en: This corpse isn't flesh and blood.

s.zh: 巫妖与死灵造物的尸体不能吞没。
s.en: The corpses of liches and necromantic constructs can't be engulfed.

s.zh: 不能吞没同族流浆人的尸体。
s.en: Can't engulf the corpse of a fellow oozefolk.

s.zh: 干尸里已经没有可以消化的东西了。
s.en: There's nothing left to digest in the dried corpse.

s.zh: 只有成年流浆人能分裂。

s.en: Can only split on a map.

s.zh: 分裂出了一个新生的流浆人。
不能渗进未探索的地方。
门的另一侧没有可以站的地方（或者路上隔着墙）。
s.en: There's nowhere to stand on the other side of the door (or a wall is in the way).

s.zh: 中间隔着墙，渗不过去（只能穿门）。
s.en: There's a wall in between; can't seep through (only through doors).
There's no door between you and the target.
Can only seep through one door at a time.

s.zh: \n不会自然流失。每吃一顿+3；吞没人形尸体+25，动物按体型×15（最多30），开始腐烂的减半。\n分裂80、重塑40、析出凝胶25、渗过10。
s.en: \nDoesn't drain naturally. +3 per meal; engulfing a humanlike corpse +25, animals body size ×15 (max 30), halved if starting to rot.\nSplit 80, reshape 40, exude gel 25, seep 10.

s.zh: 没有缺失的外部部位，也没有永久伤疤。
s.en: No missing external parts and no permanent scars.

s.zh: 一名流浆人开局原生质

s.en: the Thayan expedition sends a pursuit team of about
